verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents multiple import paths covering the whole business: prebuilt connectors for carts/billing/ERPs/accounting platforms (docs-1, docs-16), REST API/SDK-based transaction sync for custom integrations (docs-2, docs-10, docs-19), CSV file upload for backfilling history (docs-22), and explicit guidance to backfill a full prior calendar year plus current data so nexus detection covers the whole business (docs-3). This directly matches the story's requirement of API backfills plus connector syncs from other processors/storefronts. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that specific named processors (e.g., Shopify, Stripe) actually sync reliably, and a public OpenAPI spec was not reachable via probe, slightly weakening confidence in API completeness.
